title: Integral proper base change on localizing categories
statement:
For a cartesian square with $p:X\to Y$ proper, $g:Y'\to Y$, $p':X'\to Y'$ and
$g':X'\to X$, the base change map $g^*Rp_*\to Rp'_*g'^*$ is an isomorphism of
functors $\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))\to\Loc(\Dbc(Y',\mathcal O_E))$.

proof.text: Present the embedded finite extension E by the field range F of its Q_ell-algebra embedding in PadicAlgCl. The induced algebra equivalence restricts to a ring equivalence of the integer rings: the defining norms are the same after embedding. This equivalence is an isometry for the induced norms, so postcomposition on continuous functions and its inverse give an isomorphism of condensed ring objects. These are the proved private helpers coefficientMonIso and integral_coefficient_iso. Thus O_E satisfies the integral clause of [sk-def-localizing-closure].

blueprint_update.statement:
For a cartesian square with $p:X\to Y$ proper, $g:Y'\to Y$, $p':X'\to Y'$ and
$g':X'\to X$, the base change map $g^*Rp_*\to Rp'_*g'^*$ is an isomorphism of
functors $\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))\to\Loc(\Dbc(Y',\mathcal O_E))$.

proof.text:
On $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ the base change map is an isomorphism: this is the
integral proper base change on the condensed categories (the case $f=p$
proper of [thm-cbc-complete-proetale]; no completion of the pullback is
needed on integral constructible complexes). Both $g^*Rp_*$ and $Rp'_*g'^*$ are exact
and preserve direct sums on the localizing categories: $g^*$, $g'^*$ always
do, and $Rp_*$, $Rp'_*$ do by [sk-prop-int-compactness]. The objects on which
the natural transformation is an isomorphism thus form a localizing
subcategory containing $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$, hence all of
$\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))$ ([sk-lem-sf-determination]). This is the
argument of [sk-prop-proper-base-change-unbounded] with the integral
estimates of [sk-prop-int-compactness].
